screen.correction: The cited MCU VDDIO-0.4 V CMOS row is scoped to 2.7..3.6 V. Solving it for 1.9 V and claiming 0.77 V BOR4 margin extrapolates beyond its stated supply range. BOR4 falling minimum 2.67 V leaves 2.67..2.7 V without support from that cited row. Obtain an applicable low-supply row and verify load/pin scope before closing this gap. Subsequent low_supply_gpio_evidence resolves the row-domain gap conditionally using the4mA row; the8mA extrapolation remains invalid.
